title: Base change of the normalized projective-line Chern map
statement: For finite A killed by N and normalized transport t, if c and cprime satisfy the actual scalar Kummer Chern specifications on the projective lines over S and Sprime, then the inverse-image of c followed by the normalized shifted-line comparison equals the normalized constant comparison followed by cprime.

proof.text: By adjunction and line_normalization at a=1, the root-to-scalar generator map commutes with the prescribed coefficient-line pullback. By roots_normalization and the monomorphism μ_N→G_m, the prescribed roots comparison is the canonical one. The integral constant generator likewise commutes with pullback: transpose the proved coefficient_unit identity of SupportedDerivedUnitForget.

Prove exact-functor naturality of the Ext realization by the coefficient comparison isomorphism and the integral-generator pullback identity (class_ext_pullback). The cached canonical Ext equivalence has the standard composition formula and Mathlib mapExactFunctor_hom gives its exact inverse-image formula. Naturality of the left-derived/exact-derived isomorphism and its transported shift comparison identify this with normalized derived pullback. All cancellations are proved over arbitrary schemes before specializing to projective lines.

The actual pullbackMapTwistIso for m=1 identifies f*O(1) on P1_S with O(1) on P1_Sprime; The Picard skeleton description and this actual isomorphism identify their Picard classes. Apply the existing general Picard/H1 pullback theorem.

Apply Kummer boundary naturality to this Picard equality. Use cohomologyMap_map, the coefficient-root square, and the canonical-root comparison from step 1 to conclude equality of the specified scalar Kummer classes.

Use the public arbitrary-base bijectivity of ordinaryFiniteClass. Apply the canonical cached Ext equivalence to an Ext representative, use step 2 to compute the class of its normalized derived pullback, and apply the defining realization equation. The class equality from step 4 and injectivity then identify that normalized arrow with the specified target arrow. Cancellation of the unit comparison gives the required square.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryFiniteP1_chern_map_baseChange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {S' S : Scheme.{u}} (f : S' ⟶ S) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (hS' : IsUnit (N : Γ(S', ⊤)))
    (c : ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S) ⟶
      (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (c' : ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S') ⟶
      (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S'))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hc : ordinaryFiniteP1ChernSpec A N hA S
      ((map_natCast (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom N) ▸
        hS.map (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom) c)
    (hc' : ordinaryFiniteP1ChernSpec A N hA S'
      ((map_natCast (ProjectiveLine S' ↘ S').appTop.hom N) ▸
        hS'.map (ProjectiveLine S' ↘ S').appTop.hom) c') :
    (ordinaryFinitePullback A (ProjectiveSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) f)).map c ≫
        (ordinaryFiniteShiftedLinePullback A N hA t
          (ProjectiveSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) f)
          ((map_natCast (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom N) ▸
            hS.map (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom)).hom =
      (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A (ProjectiveSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) f)).hom ≫ c'
